lines.t: Leader: Thus says The Lord to His servant: Remember the Sabbath day, keep it holy.
Response: We shall rest in You, O Lord; we shall honor Your holy day.
Leader: Six days you shall labor, but the seventh is My delight.
Response: We shall cease from our works, and walk in Your ways.
Refrain (All together): Blessed be the Sabbath of The Lord, a sign between God and His people. Forever shall we rest in His love, forever shall we dwell in His peace.
Leader: From sunset to sunset, remember; let your household be at peace.
Response: We shall rejoice and be glad in You, for You are Lord of the Sabbath.
Leader: In the last days, darkness shall cover the earth, but My light shall shine in you.
Response: We shall be Your lampstand, a beacon for Your people.
Leader: For the King shall come quickly, and His Kingdom shall be a Sabbath.
Final Refrain (All together): Blessed be the Sabbath of The Lord, holy and set apart forever. Remember the Sabbath, and your God, and He shall remember you.
